_readme: Public beat catalogue for beats.html and the checkout (api/_lib/beats.js reads prices from here, never from the browser). Prices are in euro cents, one per license tier; leave a tier out to not sell it for that beat. Delivery files (Dropbox links) are NOT here: the repo is public, they live in the beat_files table. DEMO entries use pack audio as placeholder previews and must be replaced before publishing. Producers listed under "producers" get the verified badge when verified is true.  Set "featured": true to show a beat in the Featured section at the top of beats.html (first one is the spotlight). Beat pages (beats/<id>.html) are generated by scripts/build-beat-pages.js: run it after editing this file.
